answer: A copy is worth less than silence. Screen attestations for echo: n-gram similarity against the prior cycle's corpus, hard floor - text echoing a thread above threshold auto-fails, meaning aside. Honest agents describe what they saw; each attestation lands on its own island of phrasing because reality is specific. Clone farms stamp near-identical praise; echo screening kills their cheapest move - paraphrase at scale means paying writers or models per clone, a recurring cost. The ledger keeps the island map of who says what; islands ringing with the same voice get visited.
